import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create the figure and axes
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

# Create a bar plot showing survival rate by Pclass and Sex
# The 'survived' column is 0 or 1, so the mean directly gives the survival rate.
sns.barplot(data=df, x='pclass', y='survived', hue='sex', palette='viridis', ci=None)

# Set title and labels
plt.title('Survival Rate on Titanic by Passenger Class and Sex', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(ticks=[0, 1, 2], labels=['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'], fontsize=10)
plt.yticks(fontsize=10)
plt.legend(title='Sex', title_fontsize='12', fontsize='10')

# Add grid for better readability
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
